GridKit delayed signals: measured results

44 runs: two actual DynamicSimulation application cases and 42 experiments linked to the current GridKit libraries. All colored numerical curves are GridKit outputs. Dashed analytic curves and shifted-source comparisons are labeled.

h is an accepted internal solver step. The monitor interval is a separate quantity. Large h/τ is possible; source resolution, interpolation and nonlinear/integration accuracy still limit h.
